description: This file defines the ManageGitIgnore class responsible for managing .gitignore files within a Drupal project, including adding entries and determining whether to manage gitignore files based on project configuration and repository status.

classes.name: ManageGitIgnore
classes.description: Class responsible for managing .gitignore files in a Drupal project, including adding entries and checking repository status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IO interface and project directory.

methods.name: manageIgnored
methods.description: Manages the .gitignore files by adding entries for files that are not ignored or tracked.

methods.name: managementOfGitIgnoreEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether gitignore management is enabled based on project options and repository status.

methods.name: addToGitIgnore
methods.description: Adds specified entries to a .gitignore file in a given directory.
